info.title: FTAI Passport API
info.description: Permanent AI identities, signed records, owner-listed public profile summaries, and authenticated runtime work gates. Full passports, QR destinations and record verification require authentication. The original identity is guarded against application-level modification; infrastructure administrators remain a trust boundary.

bearerAuth.description: 90-day workspace API key, scoped to its owning account. Does not grant enrollment policy administration.

enrollmentKey.description: Operator-issued fte_ enrollment key, used only for initial enrollment. X-FTAI-Signature proving control of submitted public key is also required.

agentSignature.name: X-FTAI-Signature
agentSignature.description: Ed25519 signature over the exact canonical request in /runtime-protocol.md. Also requires X-FTAI-Agent, X-FTAI-Timestamp, X-FTAI-Nonce.

operatorSession.name: platform-managed-session
operatorSession.description: Sign in with ChatGPT through the site. The platform validates the session and injects identity; callers must not supply identity headers. Browser writes require matching Origin.

visibility.description: private: owning account only. shared: summary listed publicly; complete passport requires authentication. Defaults to private.

revision.description: Required for PATCH. Use the current server revision.

record.description: Original record input schema. Excludes correction, version, employment_end and incident_resolution.

200.description: At most 24 summaries: code, name, role, organization, status and up to four skills. No complete profiles or records. Includes total, offset and nextOffset.

get.summary: Download the original lifetime identity seal
get.description: Requires owner authentication for private passports, or an authenticated reader for listed passports. Returns permanent UUID, personnel code, issuance time, root fingerprint, original signed receipt and public key. Keep an independent trusted copy.

401.description: Authentication required; public listing does not expose a complete passport without sign-in.
